description: Per-robot fields in TBA match score_breakdown, 2022-2026, and how PitWall turns them into robot-level points. Machine-readable: pipeline/sb/perrobot.py (WP2) loads this file. See docs/SPEC.md section 4.4.
robot_index: Field name suffix Robot1..Robot3 refers to alliances.<color>.team_keys[0..2] in TBA order (TBA convention, not independently verified). A 4th team on a 4-team alliance gets null for every per-robot field.

rules.map: points = parts[].points[value] for that robot; values not listed score 0.
rules.split_once: The alliance scores the points in check_field at most once; credit them in equal shares to the robots whose value is in `qualifying`. If no robot qualifies but check_field > 0, the points stay in the alliance residual.
rules.map_bridge: points = points_level[value] if alliance field `state_field` equals `level_value`, else points_unlevel[value].
rules.chain_share: Robots with the same onstage location (value in `locations`) share a chain. The alliance check_field points are split equally among robots on chains holding 2 or more robots.
rules.location_flag: For each onstage robot, +points_per_robot if alliance boolean field `flag_prefix` + location is true.
rules.location_credit: For each location L with alliance boolean `flag_prefix` + L true, `points_per_flag` points are credited in equal shares to robots onstage at L; if none is at L, to all onstage robots; if none is onstage, to the alliance residual.

verification: verified=true means the rule reproduced the alliance check_field exactly on every alliance with a score_breakdown in the 2022-2025 dumps fetched 2026-11-11 (counts in `evidence`). WP2 re-checks every season at build time; any part whose match rate is below 0.99 is exported with active=false and is not used for Fast EPA attribution.

2026.note: No 2026 dump yet. Vendored clean_breakdown_2026 reads only alliance fields (hubScore.*, autoTowerPoints, endGameTowerPoints, energized/supercharged/traversalAchieved). FRC Events match pages show per-robot 'Auto Tower' and 'Endgame Tower' rows (Endgame Tower values like 'None, None, None'), so per-robot tower fields exist; the TBA field names and value strings below are inferred from TBA's naming pattern and the alliance field names. Point values are from memory of the game manual. Everything here is unverified until WP2 sees real data; the build-time check (match rate >= 0.99 against check_field) decides whether each part is used.
